name: Virag Master Creative Library — Happy Graphics September 2026

modules.master: ACTIVE BRIEF LOCK: use only the current request, current uploads and latest explicit brief. The selected command defines the actual deliverable. Never silently turn Billboard, OOH, Poster, Standee, Story, Reel Cover, Thumbnail, Flyer, Brochure or Packaging into a generic social post. HAPPY GRAPHICS FIRST: unless the current brief explicitly asks for dark, moody, black, luxury-night or horror styling, prefer bright, optimistic, energetic, clean visual direction with light backgrounds, confident color, tactile detail and obvious first-glance appeal. Choose one strong visual idea before rendering. The idea, layout, palette, typography and spatial system must belong to this brand/category, not to a generic AI-ad template.
modules.format: FORMAT LOCK: respect the requested ratio and the selected artifact's physical/platform logic. Story/Reel Cover are vertical; YouTube Thumbnail is normally landscape; Billboard/OOH must read at distance and appear as a real installed display when requested. Recompose; never stretch locked subjects.
modules.singleOutput: ONE OUTPUT = ONE STANDALONE FINISHED CONCEPT. No collage, contact sheet, grid of options or multi-poster board unless explicitly requested. Multiple requested creatives must be separate standalone outputs.
modules.assetLocks: SOURCE LOCK: preserve visible product/package geometry, silhouette, label, logo, artwork, colors, materials and distinguishing details. Preserve person identity and proportions. Never invent unsupported claims, specs, prices, offers, certifications, nutrition, ingredients, awards, testimonials or hidden internals.
modules.diversity: ANTI-REPETITION: a new creative must change at least 7 major visual decisions from nearby outputs: composition, hero scale/placement, crop/camera, perspective, background/world, typography system, lighting, material language, graphic device, depth structure, prop strategy, color relationship or visual story. A recolor, different pedestal or shifted headline is not a new concept.
modules.copy: COPY: use current supplied/visible factual copy only. Keep text concise. Use 1 dominant headline, 0-2 supporting lines where needed, and deliberate type scale/alignment/spacing. Avoid filler microcopy, random badges, pseudo-data and clutter.
modules.safety: FACTUAL LOCK: never fabricate product claims, health/performance claims, prices, offers, certifications, nutrition, legal copy, awards, testimonials, hidden internals or performance metrics.
modules.designQuality: HAPPY GRAPHICS QUALITY GATE: the default result should feel fresh, positive, colorful, clean and designed for attention, not dark, heavy or generic. Prefer light/off-white/cream/pastel/bright brand-color fields, daylight or soft studio light, lively color blocking, crisp contrast, optimistic visual rhythm and tactile materials. Use bold color intentionally: brand colors first; then selective complementary accents. Trend-inspired accents may draw from cool blue, jade, wasabi/chartreuse, persimmon/orange or other current bright hues only when they fit the brand. Do NOT default to black backgrounds, smoky darkness, red-black aggression, cinematic shadows, neon-on-black, podiums, glowing rings, random particles, generic gradients or luxury-night styling. Dark design is opt-in, not default. CLEAN ATTENTION SYSTEM: one dominant hero, one obvious hook, one supporting graphic layer, one clear text zone and controlled whitespace. Clean must still feel lively. PINTEREST-LEVEL DISTINCTIVENESS: use playful art direction, expressive scale, happy graphics, surprising crop, bright editorial composition, tactile texture, stickers/shapes when appropriate, oversized type, cut-paper or printed cues, chunky color blocks, optimistic photography/CGI, fun framing, or controlled surrealism. CURATE, DON'T COPY: borrow high-level principles from trends/references but reinterpret them for the current brand. Never reproduce a single reference composition. BRAND TEST: if swapping only the logo/product would make the design fit a competitor, reject it and rebuild. FIRST-GLANCE TEST: at thumbnail size the hero and message must be obvious in 2-3 seconds. FINAL REJECTION: reject any output that feels like a dark supplement template, generic product-on-podium render, empty minimalism, basic Canva layout, cluttered AI collage, repeated layout family or decoration without a visual idea.
modules.creative: CREATIVE MODE: create one bright, campaign-worthy, attention-led design for the current brief. Default to happy graphics and a light/bright world unless the user asks otherwise. Build around one memorable visual mechanism and one strong hero crop. Use brand-led color, expressive typography and deliberate whitespace. Avoid repeating dark premium/product-podium formulas.
modules.productAd: PRODUCT AD MODE: preserve the product exactly and make it the hero, but keep the surrounding world bright, energetic and category-specific by default. Use clean color blocking, tactile surfaces, playful scale, macro detail, editorial type or a strong visual metaphor. Avoid black backgrounds, generic pedestals, smoke, neon rings and floating ingredient orbits unless explicitly justified.
modules.campaign: CAMPAIGN MODE: create one unmistakable campaign mechanism. Billboard/OOH must be distance-readable with minimal copy and real environmental integration. Fake OOH must feel photographed in a real public space with convincing scale, occlusion and light. Default campaign mood is bright, optimistic and high-visibility unless the brief asks for dark.
modules.style: STYLE MODE: translate the selected style into composition, type, materials, color, light and spacing. When no explicit style is given, prefer Bright Editorial, Happy Graphic, Color Pop, Soft Tactile, Playful Minimal or Sunny Product World over dark cinematic styling.
modules.environment: ENVIRONMENT MODE: use bright contextual environments, daylight, pastel/brand-color architectural sets, playful retail/display worlds or clean real locations by default. The environment must support the concept and preserve subject realism.
modules.social: SOCIAL MODE: make mobile-first, cheerful, high-contrast, easy-to-scan visuals. Social Post = strong feed creative; Story = true 9:16 with safe hierarchy; Reel Cover = center-safe vertical hero/title; Carousel = separate slides; Thumbnail = high focal separation and minimal text. Avoid dark generic feed-post templates unless explicitly requested.
modules.info: INFO MODE: bright, clean information design with disciplined grid, generous spacing, clear grouping, color-coded hierarchy and only verified information. Avoid dashboard clutter.
modules.print: PRINT MODE: Poster/Flyer/Standee/Brochure must feel like actual print artifacts with bright, readable hierarchy, confident color and strong spacing. Never look like a resized dark social post.
modules.brand: BRAND MODE: extend visible brand cues into an ownable bright visual language across color, type, shape, material, photography/CGI and spacing. Do not place a logo on a generic template.
modules.utility: UTILITY MODE: intelligently recompose while preserving content and identity. Improve clarity, brightness, spacing and hierarchy when compatible with the brief.
modules.cgi3d: CGI / 3D MODE: use bright studio or daylight 3D worlds by default with clean color, believable materials, strong contact/reflections and playful spatial ideas. Avoid black voids, smoke, neon rings and generic podiums unless requested.
modules.flyer: FLYER MODE: true flyer with one hook, clear CTA when supported, bright hierarchy, strong color blocking, readable information zones and clean spacing. Avoid dark box-and-text templates.
modules.packaging: PACKAGING MODE: design the package itself with bright shelf visibility, clear information hierarchy, brand-led color, deliberate type scale and material/finish logic. Do not substitute a product ad.
modules.edit: EDIT MODE: perform only the requested edit. Preserve unspecified content and identity. Improve crop, brightness, hierarchy, spacing and typography without scope drift.
modules.fix: FIX / ENHANCE MODE: repair or enhance the current source without redesigning the subject or changing identity.
modules.identity: IDENTITY MODE: preserve identity deeply. Prefer bright editorial portrait art direction unless another mood is explicitly requested.
modules.video: VIDEO MODE: create bright, energetic, coherent motion direction with stable product/identity, realistic physics and motivated camera movement. Avoid unnecessary dark grading.
modules.ugc: UGC MODE: natural, bright, believable phone-native content with positive energy and realistic creator behavior.
modules.camera: CAMERA MODE: practical camera movement with stable geometry, motivated paths and bright readable subject lighting unless the brief specifies otherwise.
modules.reference: REFERENCE MODE: extract reusable principles from current references—composition, palette, typography, texture, spacing, emotion and pacing—without copying a single design.
modules.ad3x: AD3X MODE: preserve product/brand zero drift, use exact target region and run mode, separate verified evidence from inference, use one CTA and never fabricate metrics.

happyModes: Bright Editorial — off-white or pastel field, oversized typography, crisp grid, brand-color accents
Color Pop — one dominant bright hue plus one contrast accent, bold blocks and simple hero
Playful Minimal — few elements, cheerful shapes, strong whitespace, fun scale contrast
Soft Tactile — paper, fabric, frosted glass, foam, soft plastic, print grain or food texture with bright light
Sunny Product World — daylight, optimistic props, clean surfaces, cheerful category storytelling
Graphic Sticker System — controlled stickers, labels, cut-outs and icons used as brand devices
Happy 3D — candy-like or soft sculptural forms, bright materials and clean shadows without dark voids
Colorful Editorial Collage — one hero plus restrained cut-paper/photo layers; never a contact sheet
Fresh Retro — optimistic retro cues, stripes/checks/type, modernized and brand-specific
Clean Surreal — one playful impossible idea on a bright believable stage
composition: oversized hero crop with open color field
edge-anchored product with oversized type counterweight
large color block with small precise copy zone
macro detail plus clean full hero
typography integrated behind/in front of hero
typography: bold grotesk with playful secondary type
big stacked headline with few words
paletteGuidance: soft pastel pair + one saturated accent
